fact: The WSIS Forum 2026 session description says DRC's HandiConnect lets users reach state services and receive government-to-person social protection payments over USSD on basic phones, backed by the Ministry of Telecommunications, the Ministry delegated to Persons with Disabilities and FONA.

Biometric Update, citing the national news agency, reports the DRC launched the RDC-Pass national digital identity platform in Kinshasa, which supports unified access to e-government services via a single login, with a phased rollout beginning with pilot testing.

Biometric Update reports RDC-Pass, the national digital ID platform, gives unified access to e-government services via a single login and is described as a central gateway for service delivery across government agencies.
